title: Can I continue therapy at Pinnacle Blooms if I move cities?
metaTitle: Transitioning Therapy Across Cities | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: With Pinnacle Blooms Network’s platforms in multiple cities and online, transition your child's therapy seamlessly if you need to move.
html: Absolutely! With Pinnacle Blooms Network's presence in many cities across India, your child's therapy can continue uninterrupted. We even offer online therapy sessions broadening our reach. So, wherever you go, rest assured, we're there with you.
